channel.title: Jaeheung Lee | Manufacturing & Process Engineer
channel.description: Manufacturing and process-engineering portfolio covering battery production, semiconductor components, equipment FAT/SAT, quality improvement, and manufacturing DX

item.title: 2170 Assembly-Line Good-Yield Stabilization
item.description: Equipment-reported yield and full-inspection good yield did not agree, so true process defects and inspection misclassification had to be separated under one basis. I contributed to the team result of stabilizing monthly average good yield from about 40% to 98.7% and directly revised the MSA criteria, SOP, QCP, P-FMEA, and inspection standards.

item.title: 4695 Battery Assembly-Line Equipment Stabilization and Limited-Production Setup
item.description: Product development and SAT were complete, but the actual new product was not reflected in laser, AI-vision, and X-ray conditions, while line interlocks and repeated motion remained dependent on manual operation and temporary recipes. Two 100-cell full-process lots and a final 50-cell continuous run validated the limited-production setup, followed by management approval and handoff of the field standards.

item.title: 25P LFP Power Cell DMADV and Taguchi NPI Process Development with Customer Qualification
item.description: A new cell with simultaneous changes in electrolyte, clad tabs, turn count, and can geometry had to be advanced on the existing 2170 line from PROTO through MP technical approval. Completed about 20,000-cell trial production and customer qualification/CCB.PO technical approval, with process, inspection, and production-handoff documents established.

item.title: Next-Generation 2170 Tabless A-Sample Early Manufacturing Validation (PoC)
item.description: Without dedicated tabless equipment or jigs, existing 4695 equipment and manual work had to meet the safety and functional CTQs of a PROTO A sample. Narrowed failure modes across about 100 trials and confirmed A-sample feasibility through Hi-Pot, IR, formation, capacity, and life evaluation on five functional samples.

item.title: NCM Prismatic Pilot-Line Acceptance and Initial Stabilization
item.description: Acceptance gap between supplier function completion and actual pilot-production readiness About five days and 1,000 pilot cells; roughly 95% initial assembly result including conforming rework; standard handoff

item.title: Cylindrical-Cell Alternative Can Supplier Qualification and Pilot Transition
item.description: One incumbent can supplier could not cover planned volume alone, and alloy, thickness, tolerance, and burr differences had to be checked for assembly, sealing, welding, and vent-safety impact. Three 200-cell lots, 600 cells in total, and official UN38.3 passed, followed by a March 2025 transition of pilot production and purchase orders to the alternative can.

item.title: NCM Pre-Forming Uncoated-Edge Damage / Short Control and Pilot-Jig Validation
item.description: Positive Al-foil tearing, negative heavy-edge shedding, shorts, and manual position variation before pre-welding Pilot-jig and later-sample use with SOP, QCP, P-FMEA, inspection, training, and production-equipment RFQ handoff

item.title: Vacuum Transfer-Robot Overhaul Standard System and Field Setup
item.description: Latent alignment, leak, loaded-alarm, and teaching failures caused by missing parts, assembly, and inspection standards YMC initial qualification and about five units; Bontech repeat overhaul, OJT, and domestic/overseas site setup

item.title: High-Temperature Anodizing Process Development and Qualification for Display Equipment Parts
item.description: Redesign of cracks, particles, Hi-Pot, and large-area uniformity for higher OLED and new PECVD temperature requirements Customer qualification and product application for both films; run-sheet, process-standard, and inspection-criteria revision

item.title: Mixed-Acid Anodizing Bath Analysis and Replenishment Redesign
item.description: Mismatch between a normal titration value and film-performance degradation with bath age Component-analysis, replenishment, product-sample, and bath-replacement criteria; SOP, log, and training handoff

item.title: CVD and PECVD Component Process Reconfiguration and Technical Qualification
item.description: Gap between legacy process/inspection conditions and product-family specifications and Hi-Pot disposition One audit finding closed through seven readings and three retests; technical qualification and about one year of follow-on supply

item.title: Diffuser Ultrasonic Stripping Scale-up Failure Analysis and R&D Stop Gates
item.description: Chemical removal after missing exhaust infrastructure and erosion, particle, and reuse failure in water-plus-ultrasonic scale-up Scale-up stop and legacy-process return; mandatory relative-motion, surface-damage, reuse, and EHS gates

item.title: NCM Pilot-Line Production Traceability Automation Tool
item.description: Process MES and Excel records existed without a cell-S/N path across the full process; ten-cell history work took about three days About three minutes for ten-cell search and half a day including report; shared roll segment identified, field root cause confirmed, and user handoff completed

item.title: GIGA Press Virtualization and AI Process-Engineering Copilot Platform Design
item.description: Fragmented PLC, virtual-equipment, monitoring, and history data prevented a common basis for bottleneck and expansion decisions Normal Factory I/O→PLC→OPC UA→SCADA/SQLite→web demonstration and a read-only state-to-advisory-output structure

item.title: Legacy Robot-Data Integration for an Automotive Assembly Digital Twin Platform
item.description: Robot programs and equipment state were isolated in pendants and separate files, making full-process PC integration and Digital Twin reuse difficult. The team demonstrated QR input through Robot C routing; the later public code established JSON round trip, a Robot Controller, MQTT/DB, and read-only Twin state paths.

item.title: Weld-Specimen Vision AI Domain-Gap Reduction and Field-Oriented Decision Design
item.description: A domain gap with 15.84% recall and 35.87% FPR on directly captured specimens 85.15% recall after augmentation, 96.04% two-model F1, zero FN and 100% recall at threshold 0.40, and a FastAPI/PWA demo

item.title: Practical RAG Knowledge Retrieval for Traditional Manufacturers (HeungTology)
item.description: Fragmented terminology, formats, links, and the cost of finding source manufacturing documents again Incremental indexing of new and changed documents, ranked sources with integrity state, and a local manufacturing-knowledge retrieval prototype

item.title: Checking Evidence and Approval Before AI Takes Action
item.description: An AI reading material and proposing work does not grant execution authority or prove safe completion. The current result defines evidence, work scope, human approval, stop, and result-verification order. Restricted execution, an authorization UI, and external state checks can extend it into an execution-oriented agent.

item.title: Study Masterbook for Maintenance Engineer Exam Candidates
item.description: Exam answers, theory, and image rights come from different evidence, so fluent AI completion can create incorrect learning material. The masterbook publishes only supported items and keeps conflicting or rights-uncertain material on HOLD.

item.title: Guidebook for Common Unemployment Benefit Questions
item.description: Similar questions can produce different outcomes based on separation reason, insured period, documents, and individual notice; a website should not decide eligibility. The operating guide helps users find facts, documents, and official channels rather than issuing personal determinations.

item.title: Deep Learning Model Study Log
item.description: Running example code is different from an experiment whose data, settings, and evaluation can be explained again. The current result is a checklist for data, configuration, and evaluation in manufacturing AI experiments. It can be extended into reproducible experiment cases by connecting notebooks, data sources, settings, and results.
